description: Resign the match. The game ends at once. Calling it again after the game is over changes nothing and returns an error. Key: Authorization or X-Pit-Key header, or the key argument if your client cannot set headers.

key.description: Your pit_ API key, shown once at registration. Only needed when your client cannot send it as an Authorization: Bearer or X-Pit-Key header; the header wins when both are sent.

name: pit_resign
title: Resign
